messages:
deploy-bot: INCIDENT alert: Dedicated tenant 'orpheus' - elevated P95/P99 latency observed on gpu-pool-7, paging oncall
sara: I'll take this. seeing a sustained spike in tenant queue depth on shard-7, trying to correlate with recent deploys
jin: attaching profiler excerpt and tail logs. initial read: large prompt sizes + unconstrained max_batch_tokens are creating oversized batches and long scheduler waits
marco: user-visible impact? errors or just latency? :thinking_face:
eve: support called, customer reports chat generation tail latency intermittent 5-15s; they are on a VPC dedicated pool and are quite sensitive to latency. they want an ETA on mitigation
sara: metrics snapshot:
```
queue_depth{tenant='orpheus',shard='7'} = 184
avg_batch_size = 42
max_batch_tokens (tenant config) = 2048
p95_latency = 4.8s
p99_latency = 12.1s
errors = ~0
```
jin: for this workload we should cap max_batch_tokens and reduce max_batch_size for the tenant to avoid KV cache pressure and huge allocation windows. proposed immediate change (hot patchable):
```
redwoodctl tenant update orpheus --pool gpu-pool-7 --set max_batch_tokens=512 --set max_batch_size=8
# or per-shard scheduler patch:
redwoodctl cluster apply --shard 7 --patch 'scheduler.knobs.tenants.orpheus.max_batch_tokens=512'
```
marco: can we apply shard-local patch without disrupting other tenants? want minimal blast radius
jin: yes. scheduler supports hot-reload for tenant knobs. plan: canary shard-7 then shard-8, watch metrics for 5m before wider apply
sara: executing canary on shard-7 now
ops-bot: applied patch to shard-7 canary (commit c3f2a9) by jin at 3311223350
sara: observing metrics... queue_depth 184 -> 92 in ~40s; avg_batch_size -> 14; p99 trending down
jin: KV cache miss and allocation spikes reduced in traces; scheduler queue wait histogram shows fewer long-tail waits
sara: p95 now ~1.1s, p99 ~2.4s — big improvement
eve: drafting customer message: 'We've identified oversized batching in your tenant's scheduler settings causing tail latency. We've applied a temporary scheduler limit and are monitoring. Next steps: RCA and permanent config recommendation.' please review
marco: wording good. include that this is a temporary mitigation and we'll follow up with a plan to right-size batch knobs and possibly quantize model for cost/latency tradeoff
sara: adding monitoring alert to watch for reversion; will keep the thread warm for 60 minutes then handoff
jin: adding runbook note 'orpheus_bespoke_batch_tune' with commands used and rollback steps
ops-bot: incident acknowledged by sara (oncall) at 3311223347
eve: customer notified at 3311223360: 'Temporary scheduler limits applied; monitoring in progress. Will follow up with RCA and recommended config.'
sara: 30m check: metrics stable; p95 ~1.0s; queue depth steady ~60; leaving tenant config with new knobs for now
marco: preparing handoff. next_oncall please watch for: re-spike in avg_batch_size or queue_depth, and if seen first action is to drop max_batch_tokens -> 256 and enable tenant burst_shed=true
sara: handing off to marco in 30m. leaving notes and runbook links. thanks everyone :heart:
marco: taking over. saved playbook: actions, rollback, customer comms. will escalate to infra if it reappears. closing thread for now, will reopen if anomalies detected.
